DatasetDescription: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings of 12 subjects listening to continuous narrative speech. This dataset investigates speech processing by examining signatures of local and unified predictive models in neural responses. MEG data are in FIFF format, processed with MNE-Python. MRI data are derived from the fsaverage template with subject-specific scaling parameters.
